# wso2is_sms_sender (Resource)

Manages the tenant's SMS provider. In the Console, this is **Notification Channels > SMS Provider**. The server uses it for SMS one-time passwords and SMS notifications. Each tenant has one SMS provider. To import, use the ID `SMSPublisher`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_sms_sender" "twilio" {
  provider_name = "Twilio"
  provider_url  = "https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/ACxxxx/Messages.json"
  key           = "ACxxxx"
  secret        = var.twilio_token
  sender        = "+15550000000"
  content_type  = "FORM"
}

variable "twilio_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_type` (String) `JSON` or `FORM`, the format of requests to the provider.
- `provider_name` (String) `Twilio`, `Vonage`, `AWSSNS` or `Custom`.

### Optional

- `authentication_properties` (Map of String, Sensitive) Authentication properties, for example `username`/`password` (BASIC), `accessToken` (BEARER), `header`/`value` (API_KEY), `clientId`/`clientSecret`/`tokenEndpoint`/`scopes`. The server never returns this value.
- `authentication_type` (String) How the server signs in to a custom provider's endpoint. The allowed values are `BASIC`, `CLIENT_CREDENTIAL`, `BEARER`, `API_KEY` and `NONE`.
- `key` (String) Account key or ID (Twilio account SID, Vonage key). With BASIC authentication the server reports the username here.
- `properties` (Map of String) Additional properties, for example `body` (request template with `{{mobile}}` and `{{body}}` placeholders), `http.client.method`, `http.headers`.
- `provider_url` (String) Provider endpoint (required for `Custom`).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Account secret or token.
- `sender` (String) Sender number or ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `SMSPublisher`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_sms_sender.twilio SMSPublisher
```
